Preheat the oven to 170°C and line a baking pan with parchment paper. 2. Brown 113g of unsalted butter in a saucepan until golden, then set aside. 3. Melt the chopped chocolate in the microwave in short bursts until smooth, then stir in the browned butter and let cool slightly. 4. In a separate bowl, whisk the sugar and eggs until light and fluffy. 5. Add the chocolate butter mixture to the eggs and sugar, and whisk until fully combined. 6. Fold in the flour, cocoa powder, and salt until just incorporated. 7. Pour all of the brownie batter into the prepared pan, smooth the top, and bake for 22 minutes. Let cool completely in the pan. 8. In a pan over medium heat, melt 2 tbsp of butter. Add the finely chopped kunafa pastry and cook, stirring often, until golden and crisp. Let cool slightly. 9. Mix the toasted kunafa pastry with the pistachio cream until fully combined, then spread evenly over the cooled brownie. 10. Place the pan in the fridge for about 30 minutes to set. 11. For the ganache, place the double cream and chopped milk chocolate in a microwave-safe bowl. Heat in short bursts, stirring in between, until melted and glossy. 12. Pour the ganache over the pistachio-kunafa layer, spread evenly, and refrigerate, ideally overnight, or at least 1 hour before slicing. Enjoy! 🤎 #baking #dubaichocolate #brownies #recipe #fall

If there is one meal that belongs on your fall dinner table, it’s a cozy pot roast. Slow cooked until tender, served over creamy mashed potatoes and finished with a rich broth. It’s the ultimate comfort meal for fall 🍂 Full recipe down below, you can also find it in the link in my bio 🤎  Beef pot roast Ingredients: 	⁃	2-3 lb chuck roast 	⁃	1 medium white onion, sliced 	⁃	3 celery stalks, diced 	⁃	3 large carrots, sliced  	⁃	Bite size potatoes 	⁃	5 garlic cloves, minced 	⁃	Rosemary  	⁃	Thyme 	⁃	2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce 	⁃	3 tbsp tomato paste 	⁃	2 Au jus gravy packets 	⁃	6 cups beef bone broth 	⁃	3 tbsp unsalted butter 	⁃	2 tbsp onion powder 	⁃	2 tbsp garlic powder 	⁃	Salt to taste Instructions: Wash and prep all of your vegetables. Peel and dice the carrots, slice the onion, mince the garlic, and dice the celery. Season the chuck roast to your liking. I used onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Make sure to season all sides of the roast. Add oil to a Dutch oven and sear the roast on all sides for 3–4 minutes per side. Remove the roast from the pot and set aside. Add the celery and onion to the pot and cook over medium heat until the onion has caramelized. Add the minced garlic last to prevent it from burning. Add the tomato paste, Worcestershire sauce, and gravy packets. Add ½ cup of beef broth to deglaze the pot, then pour in the remaining broth. Add the seasonings and taste to make sure everything is seasoned to your liking. Add the roast back to the pot, along with the carrots, potatoes, butter, and a bunch of rosemary and thyme tied together with butcher’s twine. Cover and place in a 350°F oven for 3 hours. About 30 minutes before the roast is finished, prepare the mashed potatoes. To assemble, add a bed of mashed potatoes to a plate, then top with the roast, potatoes, and carrots. Finish with some of the broth and fresh or dried parsley. Enjoy! 🤎 #fall #fallrecipes #potroast #cozyvibes #fallvibes

It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice. Enjoy! 🤍

Crockpot Mongolian Beef & Noodles 🥩🍜🔥 Crockpot Series Episode 7: Mongolian Beef & Noodles This is my crockpot series, where I help you make easy recipes so good you might find a spouse or impress the one you’ve got. Tender chuck roast, a sweet and savory Mongolian-style sauce, and noodles coated in all that flavor. We sear the beef for extra color, then the crockpot does the work and you take the credit! 🙌🏽🔥 Ingredients: 2 pounds thinly sliced chuck roast 4 tablespoons butter, for searing 1 cup low-sodium shoyu 1 cup brown sugar 1 cup low-sodium beef broth 2 tablespoons minced garlic 1 tablespoon grated ginger 2 tablespoon sesame oil 2 tablespoons rice vinegar 1 teaspoon black pepper 2 tablespoons cornstarch 2 tablespoons cold water 12 ounces precooked lo mein noodles. I used yakisoba noodles brand is Fortune. Sliced green onions Sesame seeds, optional Instructions: 1. Season your beef with SPG or your favorite seasoning. Heat a skillet over high heat with the butter and sear the beef in small batches for 1-2 minutes per side. You’re building color, not cooking it through. 2. Transfer the beef to the crockpot. Deglaze the skillet with a splash of the measured beef broth, scrape up those browned bits, and pour everything into the crockpot. 3. Add the remaining broth, shoyu, brown sugar, garlic, ginger, sesame oil, and black pepper. Stir gently. 4. Cover and cook on LOW for 4 to 5 hours or HIGH for 2.5 to 3.5 hours. Start checking early so the thin beef stays tender without falling apart. 5. Mix the cornstarch slurry with a cup of broth. Stir the slurry into the sauce and cook on HIGH for 15–20 minutes, until thick and glossy. 6. Slice the green onions into 1 inch piece. Separate the precooked noodles and add them directly to the crockpot. Toss everything together and heat on HIGH for 5–10 minutes. 7. Finish with sliced green onions, sesame seeds, and chili crisp oil if you want some heat then serve immediately. Don’t leave those noodles sitting on KEEP WARM—they’ll keep drinking up the sauce. Save this one for an easy weeknight dinner! 🍜🔥 #crockpotrecipes #crockpot #EasyRecipe #hawaiitiktok #mongolianbeef

Strawberry Pull-Apart Bread 🍓✨ Dough: 3 cups all-purpose flour (360g) 5 tbsp melted butter (71g) 3 tbsp granulated sugar (38g) 1 tsp salt (6g) 2¼ tsp active dry yeast (7g) 1 large egg (50g) ¾ cup warm milk (180g) 1 tsp vanilla extract Simple Glaze: 1 cup powdered sugar (120g) 1–2 tbsp milk (15–30g) 1 tbsp melted butter (14g) Splash of vanilla extract Strawberry Compote Ingredients:  300g strawberries (about 2 cups, chopped) 75–90g granulated sugar (6–7 tbsp) 1 tbsp lemon juice 10–12g cornstarch (1–1½ tbsp) 30g water (2 tbsp) Instructions: In a bowl, mix warm milk, sugar, and yeast and let sit for 8–10 minutes until foamy, then add the egg, melted butter, and vanilla and mix until combined; add in the flour and salt and knead for about 8–10 minutes until smooth, then cover and let rise for 1 hour or until doubled. Fruity Pebble Ice Cream Taco #shorts #food #recipe Full Recipe 👇🏿 Fruity Pebbles Choco Tacos Yield: 6–8 tacos TOOLS NEEDED Mixing bowls Fine mesh strainer Electric hand mixer Rubber spatula Waffle cone maker Taco shell holder Pastry brush Microwave-safe bowl Ice cream scoop or piping bag --- BEFORE YOU START - Keep the heavy cream very cold and stop whipping just under stiff peaks so the ice cream stays light and creamy. - Shape the waffle taco shells immediately while they are still hot. Once they cool, they will crack instead of bending. - Let the taco shells cool completely before adding the white chocolate, and keep them upright in a taco holder anytime they are setting or freezing. --- FRUITY PEBBLES ICE CREAM Ingredients 2 cups cold heavy whipping cream, divided 1 1/2 cups Fruity Pebbles cereal, for soaking 3/4 cup sweetened condensed milk 1/2 cup Fruity Pebbles cereal, finely chopped 2 tablespoons caramel sauce Instructions 1. Add 1 1/2 cups Fruity Pebbles to a bowl and pour about 1 1/2 cups of the heavy cream over the cereal. 2. Cover and refrigerate for 2–3 hours. 3. Pour the cereal and cream through a fine mesh strainer into a clean bowl. 4. Press down firmly on the soaked cereal with the back of a spoon or spatula to get as much of the Fruity Pebbles cream out as possible. 5. Discard the soaked cereal. 6. Add enough fresh cold heavy cream to the strained cream to bring it back up to about 2 cups total. 7. Whip the cream until it reaches just under stiff peaks. It should be thick and fluffy but still smooth. 8. Gently fold in the sweetened condensed milk. 9. Finely chop or crush 1/2 cup Fruity Pebbles. 10. Mix the cereal with the caramel sauce. 11. Fold the caramel Fruity Pebbles mixture into the ice cream. 12. Transfer to a freezer-safe container, cover, and freeze for 4–6 hours or until firm enough to scoop. --- WAFFLE TACO SHELLS Ingredients Prepared homemade waffle cone batter Instructions 1. Preheat your waffle cone maker. 2. Add enough batter to make a thin, even waffle and cook until golden brown. 3. As soon as it comes off the waffle cone maker, carefully fold it into a taco shape. 4. Place it in a taco shell holder or taco mold while it cools. 5. Repeat with the remaining batter and let all of the shells cool completely. --- WHITE CHOCOLATE COATING Ingredients 2 cups chopped white chocolate 1–2 tablespoons coconut oil Instructions 1. Add the chopped white chocolate and 1 tablespoon coconut oil to a microwave-safe bowl. 2. Microwave in short intervals, stirring between each one, until completely melted and smooth. 3. Add a little more coconut oil if needed to loosen the chocolate. 4. Brush a thin layer of white chocolate all over the inside of each taco shell, making sure to get down into the bottom curve. 5. Place the shells upright in a taco holder and freeze for about 10 minutes, or until the chocolate is firm. --- ASSEMBLY Ingredients Prepared Fruity Pebbles ice cream Prepared white chocolate-coated taco shells Remaining melted white chocolate 1 cup Fruity Pebbles cereal, crushed Instructions 1. Remove the ice cream from the freezer. If it is very firm, let it soften for a few minutes until it is easy to scoop. 2. Fill each taco shell with the Fruity Pebbles ice cream. 3. Press the ice cream gently into the center and sides so the taco is completely filled. 4. Smooth the exposed ice cream across the top. 5. Place the tacos upright in the taco holder and freeze until the ice cream is firm again, about 30–60 minutes. 6. Reheat the remaining white chocolate if needed. 7. Dip the exposed edge of each taco into the white chocolate, rotating from the top toward the bottom in a curved motion so the chocolate follows the shape of the taco. 8. Immediately sprinkle crushed Fruity Pebbles over the wet chocolate. 9. Return the tacos to the freezer until the chocolate is set and the ice cream is completely firm. 10. Keep frozen until ready to serve.

one of the easiest go to recipes I make all the time when I’m feeling a bit lazy but want something that feels comforting and elevated but not overly complicated! A sausage, fennel and broccoli pasta using white wine as a base with lots of chilli, garlic and lemon. Perfect for midweek!  Ingredients: 250g italian sausages (or any sausage)  150g tender stem broccoli  4 garlic cloves  1 tsp fennel seeds  1 tsp chilli flakes  1/2 a lemon  175ml dry white wine  200g pasta  50g parmesan (more to serve) Method: Remove the sausage meat from its casing and crumble into a pan. Pop onto a medium heat with a little oil to slowly render the fat for a few minutes and then turn it up to get those lovely crispy edges.  Put your pasta on to boil.  Dice shallots and mince garlic and chop the broccoli into a similar size as the sausage crumbles. Add the onion to the sausage pan and cook out for a moment before adding the minced garlic, fennel seeds and chilli flakes. Fry this all off for another minute or two stirring regularly and then pour in the white wine. Let it bubble for a minute and stir so you get all the flavour stuck to the bottom of the pan. Drag your cooked pasta over so some of the water comes with it, mix well and squeeze over lemon juice and add parmesan. Mix well, season to taste and serve with a healthy drizzle of good quality olive oil

French Onion Butter Beans Ingredients (4 servings): • 3 large yellow onions, thinly sliced • 4 oz oyster mushrooms, torn into bite-size pieces • 1-2 tbsp olive oil • 3 garlic cloves, minced • 1 tsp fresh thyme • ½ tsp black pepper • 3 cans butter beans, drained and rinsed • 1½ cups vegetable broth • 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce • 1 tsp Dijon mustard • 1 tsp balsamic vinegar • ½ cup milk • ½ cup Gruyère • Salt to taste • Fresh thyme, for finishing • Sourdough bread Instructions: 1. Caramelize the onions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet. Add onions and a pinch of salt. Cook over medium-low heat for 30–35 minutes, stirring regularly. If they start sticking, add 1–2 tbsp water at a time until the onions are deeply caramelized. 2. Add the mushrooms: Push the onions aside and add in the oyster mushrooms. Let them sit in the pan for 2 minutes to let them brown a little bit. Then saute for another 3-5  minutes and mix them into the onions. 3. Build the flavor: Add garlic, thyme and black pepper. Cook for 30 seconds. Add broth, Worcestershire, Dijon and balsamic vinegar. Scrape up all the browned bits. 4. Add the beans: Stir in the butter beans and simmer for 8–10 minutes. Mash about ¼ of the beans directly in the skillet. 5. Make it creamy: Reduce the heat to low and stir in the milk, and simmer gently for 2–3 minutes. 6. Bake: Spread the beans into an even layer and sprinkle the Gruyère over the top. Transfer to a 400°F oven and bake for about 8–10 minutes, until hot and bubbling. Then switch to broil for 1–2 minutes to get that gorgeous browned, bubbly cheese crust. Finish with fresh thyme and black pepper. Enjoy with some sourdough bread! #frenchonion #beans #beansontoast #easydinners #dinneridea

Recipe Name Creamy Garlic Shrimp Stuffed Shells Ingredients 1. 20 jumbo pasta shells 2. 1 lb large shrimp, peeled, deveined, and chopped 3. 2 tbsp butter 4. 4 cloves garlic, minced 5. 1 cup ricotta cheese 6. 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese 7. 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese 8. 1 large egg 9. 1 1/2 cups heavy cream 10. 2 tbsp cream cheese 11. 1 tsp Italian seasoning 12. 1/2 tsp paprika 13. 1/2 tsp salt 14. 1/4 tsp black pepper 15. 2 tbsp fresh parsley, chopped 16. 1 tbsp lemon juice 17. 1 tbsp olive oil Recipe 1. Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C). 2. Cook the jumbo pasta shells in salted boiling water until al dente. 3. Drain the shells and rinse them with cool water so they do not continue cooking. 4. Heat olive oil and butter in a skillet over medium heat. 5. Add the shrimp and cook for about 2 minutes per side until pink and nearly cooked through. 6. Add half of the minced garlic, paprika, salt, and black pepper. 7. Cook for another 30–60 seconds, then remove the shrimp from the heat. 8. Chop the shrimp into smaller pieces and allow it to cool slightly. 9. In a large bowl, combine ricotta, egg, Parmesan, 1/2 cup mozzarella, Italian seasoning, and fresh parsley. 10. Fold the cooked shrimp into the cheese mixture until evenly distributed. 11. Melt the cream cheese into the heavy cream in a saucepan over medium-low heat. 12. Add the remaining minced garlic and stir until the sauce becomes smooth and creamy. 13. Stir in the lemon juice and a small pinch of salt and black pepper. 14. Spread a thin layer of the creamy garlic sauce across the bottom of a baking dish. 15. Fill each pasta shell generously with the shrimp and cheese mixture. 16. Arrange the stuffed shells in the dish and pour the remaining Alfredo sauce over and around them. 17. Sprinkle the remaining mozzarella and Parmesan over the top. 18. Cover with foil and bake for 20 minutes. 19. Remove the foil and bake for another 8–10 minutes until the cheese is melted, bubbling, and lightly golden. 20. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve hot with extra creamy sauce spooned over the shells. Follow this account for more creamy, cheesy recipes that taste like restaurant favorites at home.

😋🤤save this recipe  Garlic Butter Steak with Parmesan Cream Sauce A rich, buttery steak dinner with a creamy garlic-Parmesan sauce. perfect for when you want something that feels like a steakhouse meal right at home. Ingredients: For the steak: 2 pounds steak, such as ribeye, sirloin, or strip steak 1 tablespoon olive oil 1 teaspoon salt 1/2 teaspoon black pepper 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder 3 tablespoons butter 3 cloves garlic, minced 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley For the Parmesan cream sauce: 2 tablespoons butter 3 cloves garlic, minced 1 cup heavy cream 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese 1 teaspoon Dijon mustard 1/2 teaspoon Italian seasoning 1/4 teaspoon black pepper Pinch of salt, to taste 1 tablespoon chopped chives or parsley Instructions: Pat the steaks dry with paper towels. Season both sides with salt, pepper, and garlic powder. Let them rest at room temperature for 20 minutes. Heat a large cast-iron skillet or heavy pan over medium-hiah heat for 2-3 minutes. Add olive oil and and swirl to coat the pan. Place the steaks in the hot skillet and sear for 3-5 minutes per side, depending on thickness and desired doneness. Reduce heat to medium. Add butter and minced garlic to the pan. Spoon the melted garlic butter over the steaks for 1-2 minutes. Transfer the steaks to a plate and loosely cover with foil. Let them rest for 5-10 minutes while you make the sauce. In the same skillet, melt 2 tablespoons butter over medium heat. Add minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds, stirring constantly. Pour in the heavy cream and stir, scraping up the browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Simmer gently for 3-4 minutes. Stir in Parmesan cheese, Dijon mustard, Italian seasoning, black pepper, and a pinch of salt. Cook for 2-3 minutes, until smooth and slightly thickened. Slice the steak against the grain, then spoon the Parmesan cream sauce over the top. Sprinkle with parsley or chives and serve warm with roasted potatoes, green beans.
